description: This file defines the Connection class responsible for managing a singleton database connection using Doctrine DBAL in the OrangeHRM project. It initializes the connection with project-specific parameters, registers type mappings, and provides access to the connection instance, including reset functionality.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: A singleton class managing the database connection via Doctrine DBAL, including initialization, configuration, and reset functionality.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the singleton database connection, allowing reinitialization on next request.
